activity.notes: On 18 January 1854 William Walker issued Decree No. 1 in the name of the Republic of Sonora and signed it as President of Sonora, transforming his earlier filibuster Republic of Lower California into a claimed two-state republic of Sonora and Lower California. The regime was never recognized by Mexico or internationally and never established effective control over Sonora itself; its actual base remained in Baja California. Walker crossed the United States border with his remaining followers and surrendered to U.S. authorities on 8 May 1854. ATLAS therefore labels the office Self-proclaimed President and the polity as a short-lived unrecognized filibuster regime, not a legitimate Mexican successor state.
